subject: Every string the editor.event_list surface exposes to AX in en-US
question: What labels does Logic show on editor.event_list in en-US, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in en-US whose editor.event_list rows carry the same 58 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: Display Additional Info, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Aftertouch Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Control Change Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Note Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Pitch Bend Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Poly Aftertouch Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display Program Change Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.
Display System Exclusive Events, Event Type buttons. Click to show or hide specific event types.

MIDI In   ⌥I, MIDI In button. Click to add notes to an existing MIDI region, or double-click to change pitch/velocity of a selected note in a MIDI region, using the Musical Typing or an external MIDI keyboard.
MIDI Out   ⌥O, MIDI Out button. Play MIDI events when they’re clicked, selected, or added using a MIDI editor.

conclusion: On this host in en-US, editor.event_list exposes 105 elements carrying 58 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.

9 window-level rows (the title bar, its close/minimise/zoom buttons and the unnamed containers directly under the window) belong to no area and are filed under no record; 0 further window rows matched no area rule. All are in the evidence file.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.

1 strings are neither cited nor proved absent: each is absent from Apple's corpora as bytes and a shipped label folds to it (a colon, an ellipsis, a case), so the spelling Logic ships is not something this census read: 1 1 1 1
